name: dollartime
description: Up/down price prediction markets. Anyone opens a market on any USD-quoted asset for any window (15 min to 30 days) - 'will BTC be up or down in 4h?' - at the price right now, anyone takes a side while betting is open, and it settles on the real price (Coinbase 1-minute candle) when the window ends. Parimutuel: winners split the pot; flat or one-sided markets refund. Play money, name + token, local SQLite, stdlib only.

endpoints.GET /market: One market with pools, payout multiples and bets (id)
endpoints.POST /create: Open a market {token, asset, hours, side, amount, note?, bet_minutes?}
endpoints.POST /bet: Take a side {token, id, side, amount}
endpoints.POST /resolve: Settle every due market (also runs every 30s)
